newsitem.title: USA: CBOT wheat recovers as EU sets tax on wheat export.
newsitem.headline: CBOT wheat recovers as EU sets tax on wheat export.

text.p: CBOT wheat futures turned higher in fast trading on news the European Union set a taxes on exports of soft wheat grain and flourr, traders said.
"The tax imposed in the EU on exports brought in short-covering from both commercials and funds," a trader said.
The EU on Thursday decided that a tax of 15 Ecus per tonne would apply to daily exports of soft wheat grain, France's grain office ONIC said.
A tax of 20 Ecus per tonne will apply to daily soft wheat flour exports, it said.
The taxes will become effective as soon as the relevant EU regulation is published in the official journal.
At 1120 CDT, wheat was one to 3-3/4 cents per bushel higher, with May up 1-1/4 at $4.33-1/2. July was up 3-1/4 at $4.39.
